note: Representative inputs for comparing LLM prompt versions on the SAME text. Each passage is raw transcript text; it goes through the real cleaner, sentence chunking and context grouping before the LLM. No reference glosses are included: none have been endorsed by an ISL-fluent reviewer. The automatic diagnostics in the comparison output are not a measure of translation accuracy.
